_about: SHADDAI fal production manifest — the ONLY list of things we may spend fal on. Gate 0 (MASTER-PLAN §4): no row = no spend. Edit status/approvals here; run `node fal-assets/production/preflight.mjs` to validate + rebuild the board. Caps are POLICY ceilings, not quoted prices — verify live prices at https://fal.ai/models before --go. Concept images run on Hugging Face (owner, 2026-09-24); only 3D mesh/rig/video spend fal.
style_lock: SHADDAI brand: obsidian #06080b brushed-metal base, gold #e8c45c sacred geometry accents, emerald #00ff9c energy seams, cyan #5fe0ff holographic glow. Futuristic sci-fi fantasy, clean readable silhouette, no medieval, no cartoon.
shot: single isolated object, full object in frame with 10% margin, 3/4 view, flat mid-grey studio background, soft even studio light, solid opaque surfaces.
negative: no text, no logos, no watermark, no duplicate objects, no background clutter, no cropped edges, no reflections, no perspective distortion.

family_rules.agent: full body T-pose facing camera, arms straight out at shoulder height, open empty hands, legs shoulder-width, 7.5-head realistic adult proportions (NOT chibi), 1.8m. Use forge.mjs POSE block verbatim — it is the wording that survives auto-rigging.
family_rules.building: exterior shell, ONE clearly visible ground-level doorway 2.2m x 1.2m facing camera, readable at 128px, futuristic only (no normal houses/roofs/barns). Interiors are built in CODE with existing fur-*.glb (image-to-3D cannot make usable interiors — do not pay for them).
family_rules.vehicle: side-3/4 view, whole hull visible, open cockpit/deck where the pilot sits (seat anchor is set in code), no people, no water/ground in frame.
family_rules.cosmetic: image-EDIT of the approved agent T-pose concept only — same pose, same body, only the outfit changes.
family_rules.video: image-to-video from two APPROVED agent concepts; 5s; no text.
